header.bgTitle: Connecting You to a Better Ride
header.title: MauriCab

welcome.description: Your trusted partner for safe and convenient transportation across Mauritania. We are more than just a ride-sharing app, we are your go-to solution for hassle-free travel, connecting you to reliable drivers, comfortable vehicles, and quality service.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: At MauriCab, our mission is simple yet profound: to make transportation accessible, affordable, and secure for every Mauritanian. We strive to enhance the mobility of our community by offering a seamless, trustworthy, and enjoyable travel experience.

booking.title: Easy Booking
booking.description: With a few taps, you can book a ride to any destination in Mauritania.

drivers.title: Local Drivers
drivers.description: Your driver is not just a chauffeur, they are part of your community.

tracking.title: Real-Time Tracking
tracking.description: Stay in control of your journey. Track your ride in real-time on our map

payment.title: Flexible Payment Options
payment.description: We offer various payment methods to suit your preferences
